candidate.title: Sequencing by Synthesis
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina poster schematic of adapter-mediated flowcell capture, bridge amplification, and indexed paired-end sequencing by synthesis. One continuous implementation is depicted, including P5 deblocking and unlabeled extension before Index2; bridge amplification is a component, not a separately targeted method. Input is an existing adapter-bearing library, and the output is cluster-associated first-read, Index1, Index2 and second-read sequence information plus the final sequenced material. The original biological target and upstream library preparation are not shown. The colored terminal segments have no sequence/end-group legend. This extraction does not assert applicability to all Illumina chemistries, alternative indexing orders or unshown single-cell assays.
